# Fight for Australia
> Grassroots nationalist movement site for free speech organising and the March for Australia network.

Site: https://fight4australia.org
Contact hub: https://solo.to/fightforaustralia
Email: national@marchforaus.org

- Home: https://fight4australia.org/

- Get involved: https://fight4australia.org/get-involved.html
